property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v arrays, transfer always returns true and does not revert (i.e., call completes) when invoked; if _tos is empty it must revert due to require, otherwise it returns true.
If _tos.length > 0 and v has same length as _tos, transfer returns true (does not revert) and the call returns true.
If _tos.length > 0 and v has the same length as _tos, transfer returns true (does not revert) and the call succeeds.
